propositions: rebar must not use git stash operations (push/pop/drop) in the tickets worktree, because the stash stack is shared across all worktrees of a repository and can cause foreign stashes from other branches to be applied
A shared-stash race can leave the tickets worktree index stranded with unmerged entries, blocking all store writes until manual intervention removes the corruption

The autohealing mechanism must classify unmerged paths into three buckets: regenerable files (auto-discarded), genuine ticket data (refused), and foreign paths not tracked on the tickets branch (auto-discarded like regenerable)
A supported maintenance entrypoint must exist to perform authorized raw-git mutations with durable audit logging, backup-ref creation, and refusal when unpushed ticket commits exist

A break-glass override mechanism with explicit written reason and loud output must be available for edge cases the supported entrypoint cannot cover, preventing operators from improvising unsafe raw-git commands
